G3602.et: from a derivative of the base of (1416)
G3602.def: from a derivative of the base of «1416»; moaning, i.e. lamentation:--mourning.

G3603.et: from the neuter of (3739) and the third person singular present ind. of (1510)
G3603.def: from the neuter of «3739» and the third person singular present indicative of «1510»; which is:--called, which is (make), that is (to say).

G3604.def: of Hebrew origin («05818»); Ozias (i.e. Uzzijah), an Israelite:--Ozias.

G3605.et: a root word (in a strengthened form)
G3605.def: a primary verb (in a strengthened form); to scent (usually an ill "odor"): stink.

G3606.et: from (3739) with the directive enclitic of source
G3606.def: from «3739» with the directive enclitic of source; from which place or source or cause (adverb or conjunction):--from thence, (from) whence, where(-by, -fore, -upon).

G3607.def: of uncertain affinity; a linen cloth, i.e. (especially) a sail:--sheet.

G3608.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of «3607»; a linen bandage:--linen clothes.

G3609.def: from «3624»; domestic, i.e. (as noun), a relative, adherent:--(those) of the (his own) house(-hold).

G3610.def: from «3611»; a fellow resident, i.e. menial domestic:--(household) servant.

G3611.def: from «3624»; to occupy a house, i.e. reside (figuratively, inhabit, remain, inhere); by implication, to cohabit:--dwell. See also «3625».

G3612.def: from «3611»; a tenement, i.e. (specially), a jail:--prison.

G3613.et: from a presumed derivative of (3611) (equivalent to (3612))
G3613.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of «3611» (equivalent to «3612»); a residence (literally or figuratively):--habitation, house.

G3614.def: from «3624»; properly, residence (abstractly), but usually (concretely) an abode (literally or figuratively); by implication, a family (especially domestics):--home, house(-hold).

G3615.def: from «3614»; familiar, i.e. (as noun) relatives:--they (them) of (his own) household.

G3616.def: from «3617»; to be the head of (i.e. rule) a family:--guide the house.

G3617.def: from «3624» and «1203»; the head of a family:--goodman (of the house), householder, master of the house.

G3618.def: from the same as «3619»; to be a house-builder, i.e. construct or (figuratively) confirm:--(be in) build(-er, -ing, up), edify, embolden.

G3619.et: feminine (abstract) of a compound of (3624) and the base of (1430)
G3619.def: feminine (abstract) of a compound of «3624» and the base of «1430»; architecture, i.e. (concretely) a structure; figuratively, confirmation:--building, edify(-ication, -ing).

G3621.def: from «3623»; to manage (a house, i.e. an estate):--be steward.

G3622.def: from «3623»; administration (of a household or estate); specially, a (religious) "economy":--dispensation, stewardship.

G3623.def: from «3624» and the base of «3551»; a house-distributor (i.e. manager), or overseer, i.e. an employee in that capacity; by extension, a fiscal agent (treasurer); figuratively, a preacher (of the Gospel):--chamberlain, governor, steward.

G3624.def: of uncertain affinity; a dwelling (more or less extensive, literal or figurative); by implication, a family (more or less related, literally or figuratively):--home, house(-hold), temple.

G3625.et: feminine participle present passive of (3611) (as noun, by implication of (1093))
G3625.def: feminine participle present passive of «3611» (as noun, by implication, of «1093»); land, i.e. the (terrene part of the) globe; specially, the Roman empire:--earth, world.

G3626.def: from «3624» and ouros (a guard; be "ware"); a stayer at home, i.e. domestically inclined (a "good housekeeper"):--keeper at home.

G3630.et: from (3631) and a derivative of the alternate of (4095)
G3630.def: from «3631» and a derivative of the alternate of «4095»; a tippler:--winebibber.

G3631.et: a primary word (or perhaps of Hebrew origin (03196))
G3631.def: a primary word (or perhaps of Hebrew origin («03196»)); "wine" (literally or figuratively):--wine.

G3632.et: from (3631) and a form of the base of (5397)
G3632.def: from «3631» and a form of the base of «5397»; an overflow (or surplus) of wine, i.e. vinolency (drunkenness):--excess of wine.

G3634.def: probably akin to «3588», «3739», and «3745»; such or what sort of (as a correlation or exclamation); especially the neuter (adverbially) with negative, not so:--so (as), such as, what (manner of), which.

G3635.def: from oknos (hesitation); to be slow (figuratively, loath):--delay.

G3636.def: from «3635»; tardy, i.e. indolent; (figuratively) irksome:--grievous, slothful.

G3637.def: from «3638» and «2250»; an eight-day old person or act:--the eighth day.

G3639.et: from a primary ollumi (to destroy, a prolonged form)
G3639.def: from a primary ollumi (to destroy; a prolonged form); ruin, i.e. death, punishment:--destruction.

G3640.def: from «3641» and «4102»; incredulous, i.e. lacking confidence (in Christ):--of little faith.

G3641.def: of uncertain affinity; puny (in extent, degree, number, duration or value); especially neuter (adverbially) somewhat:--+ almost, brief(-ly), few, (a) little, + long, a season, short, small, a while.

G3643.et: from a compound of (3641) and ora ("care")
G3643.def: from a compound of «3641» and ora ("care"); to have little regard for, i.e. to disesteem:--despise.

G3644.def: from «3645»; a ruiner, i.e. (specially), a venomous serpent:--destroyer.

G3646.et: from a derivative of a compound of (3650) and a derivative of (2545)
G3646.def: from a derivative of a compound of «3650» and a derivative of «2545»; a wholly-consumed sacrifice ("holocaust"):--(whole) burnt offering.

G3647.def: from «3648»; integrity, i.e. physical wholeness:--perfect soundness.

G3648.def: from «3650» and «2819»; complete in every part, i.e. perfectly sound (in body):--entire, whole.

G3649.def: a reduplicated primary verb; to "howl" or "halloo", i.e. shriek:--howl.

G3650.def: a primary word; "whole" or "all", i.e. complete (in extent, amount, time or degree), especially (neuter) as noun or adverb:--all, altogether, every whit, + throughout, whole.

G3651.def: from «3650» and «5056»; complete to the end, i.e. absolutely perfect:--wholly.

G3652.et: probably a contraction from Olumpiodoros (Olympian-bestowed, i.e. heaven-descended)
G3652.def: probably a contraction from Olumpiodoros (Olympian-bestowed, i.e. heaven-descended); Olympas, a Christian:--Olympas.

G3653.def: of uncertain derivation; an unripe (because out of season) fig:--untimely fig.

G3654.def: adverb from «3650»; completely, i.e. altogether; (by analogy), everywhere; (negatively) not by any means:--at all, commonly, utterly.

G3655.def: of uncertain affinity; a thunder storm:--shower.

G3656.def: from «3658»; to be in company with, i.e. (by implication) to converse:--commune, talk.

G3658.et: from the base of (3674) and a derivative of the alternate of (138) (meaning a crowd)
G3658.def: from the base of «3674» and a derivative of the alternate of «138» (meaning a crowd); association together, i.e. a multitude:--company.

G3659.def: from «3700»; a sight, i.e. (by implication) the eye:--eye.

G3660.et: a prolonged form of a primary but obsolete omo, for which another prolonged form (omoo {om-o'-o}) is used in certain tenses
G3660.def: to swear, i.e. take (or declare on) oath:--swear.

G3661.et: from a compound of the base of (3674) and (2372)
G3661.def: adverb from a compound of the base of «3674» and «2372»; unanimously:--with one accord (mind).

G3663.def: from «3664» and the alternate of «3958»; similarly affected:--of (subject to) like passions.

G3664.def: from the base of «3674»; similar (in appearance or character):--like, + manner.

G3666.def: from «3664»; to assimilate, i.e. compare; passively, to become similar:--be (make) like, (in the) liken(-ess), resemble.

G3667.def: from «3666»; a form; abstractly, resemblance:--made like to, likeness, shape, similitude.

G3670.et: from a compound of the base of (3674) and (3056)
G3670.def: from a compound of the base of «3674» and «3056»; to assent, i.e. covenant, acknowledge:--con- (pro-)fess, confession is made, give thanks, promise.

G3671.def: from the same as «3670»; acknowledgment:--con- (pro-)fession, professed.

G3672.def: adverb of present passive participle of «3670»; confessedly:--without controversy.

G3673.def: from the base of «3674» and «5078»; a fellow-artificer:--of the same craft.

G3674.et: genitive case of homos (the same, akin to (260)) as adv
G3674.def: genitive case of homos (the same; akin to «260») as adverb; at the same place or time:--together.

G3675.def: from the base of «3674» and «5424»; like-minded, i.e. harmonious:--of one mind.

G3676.def: adverb from the base of «3674»; at the same time, i.e. (conjunctionally) notwithstanding, yet still:--and even, nevertheless, though but.

G3678.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of «3688»; a little ass:--young ass.

G3679.def: from «3681»; to defame, i.e. rail at, chide, taunt:--cast in teeth, (suffer) reproach, revile, upbraid.

G3681.et: probably akin to the base of (3686)
G3681.def: probably akin to the base of «3686»; notoriety, i.e. a taunt (disgrace):--reproach.

G3683.def: from a derivative of «3685» and «5411»; profit-bearer; Onesiphorus, a Christian:--Onespiphorus.

G3684.def: from «3688»; belonging to a ass, i.e. large (so as to be turned by a ass):--millstone.

G3685.et: a prolonged form of an apparently primary verb (onomai, to slur), for which another prolonged form (onao) is used as an alternate in some tenses [unless indeed it be identical with the base of (3686) through the idea of notoriety]
G3685.def: a prolonged form of an apparently primary verb (onomai, to slur); for which another prolonged form (onao) is used as an alternate in some tenses (unless indeed it be identical with the base of «3686» through the idea of notoriety); to gratify, i.e. (middle voice) to derive pleasure or advantage from:--have joy.

G3686.et: from a presumed derivative of the base of (1097) (cf (3685))
G3686.def: from a presumed derivative of the base of «1097» (compare «3685»); a "name" (literally or figuratively) (authority, character):--called, (+ sur-)name(-d).

G3687.def: from «3686»; to name, i.e. assign an appellation; by extension, to utter, mention, profess:--call, name.

G3688.def: apparently a primary word; a donkey:--an ass.

G3689.def: adverb of the oblique cases of «5607»; really:--certainly, clean, indeed, of a truth, verily.

G3691.et: probably akin to the base of (188) ["acid"]
G3691.def: probably akin to the base of «188» ("acid"); keen; by analogy, rapid:--sharp, swift.

G3692.def: probably from «3700»; a hole (as if for light), i.e. cavern; by analogy, a spring (of water):--cave, place.

G3693.et: from opis (regard, from (3700)) with enclitic of source
G3693.def: from opis (regard; from «3700») with enclitic of source; from the rear (as a secure aspect), i.e. at the back (adverb and preposition of place or time):--after, backside, behind.

G3694.et: from the same as (3693) with enclitic of direction
G3694.def: from the same as «3693» with enclitic of direction; to the back, i.e. aback (as adverb or preposition of time or place; or as noun):--after, back(-ward), (+ get) behind, + follow.

G3695.def: from «3696»; to equip (with weapons (middle voice and figuratively)):--arm self.

G3696.et: probably from a primary hepo (to be busy about)
G3696.def: probably from a primary hepo (to be busy about); an implement or utensil or tool (literally or figuratively, especially, offensive for war):--armour, instrument, weapon.

G3697.pos: 1. of what sort or quality, what manner of
G3697.def: from «3739» and «4169»; of what kind that, i.e. how (as) great (excellent) (specially, as an indefinite correlative to the definite antecedent «5108» of quality):--what manner (sort) of, such as whatsoever.

G3698.def: from «3739» and «4218»; what(-ever) then, i.e. (of time) as soon as:--when.

G3699.def: from «3739» and «4225»; what(-ever) where, i.e. at whichever spot:--in what place, where(-as, -soever), whither (+ soever).
